t: Lesheb bishat qeriat shema veshello yishan
s: Lesheb bishat qeriat shema veshello yishan ubo y' seipim: kol adam qorin qeriat shema kedarkan, ben omedin ben yoshebin, ben shokebin ben mehallekin, ben rokebin al gabbe behema, shenneemar: "ubelekteka badderek", im ken lamma neemar "beshokbeka ubequmeka"? Bizman shebbene adam shokebin ubizman shebbene adam omedin. Umikkol maqom peraqdan, dehaynu shehu muttal upanayv tuchot baqqarqa o mushlak al gabbayv upanayv lemala, apillu im hu beinyan sheen issur bishkiba zo mishshum chashash shemma yabo lide qishshuy kegon shemmutteh al tziddo meat — asur liqrot qeriat shema ad sheyyithappek al tziddo legamre, mippene shemmeqabbel malkut shamayim derek serara vegaava, ella im ken haya baal basar harbeh veeno yakol lehithappek al tziddo o shehu choleh. Veyesh omerim sheapillu leshokeb al tziddo lo hittiru liqrot kak ella kesheshshokeb arom tachat sedino, shello hitrichu alayv laamod velilbosh begadayv. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona:

Mi sherotzeh lehachamir laamod keshehu yosheb veliqrotah meummad — niqra abaryan, sheober al dibre chakamim. Veap shehachakamim hittiru gam meummad, mikkol maqom kevan shellepi dibrehem en maala kelal bimummad mibbeyosheb, shezzeh shenneemar "ubequmeka" en hakkatub medabber kelal baamida ella bizman qima, vehu machmir laamod — hare nireh sheeno choshesh ledibrehem uleperusham bakkatub, vechayyab mita. Veen domeh kelal lishar chumrot sheanu machamirin meezeh taam bemah sheheqellu chakamim, sheap chakamim hayu modim sheyyesh maala bechumra meoto taam, ella shello ratzu lehachamir:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyosheb sheomed, abal im haya mehallek verotzeh laamod veliqrot kol hag' parashiyyot shel qeriat shema kede sheyyukal lekavven heteb — rashay vetabo alayv beraka, kevan sheeno mitkavven baamida ella bishbil hakkavvana, mah sheen ken bayosheb sheyyukal lekavven kemo meummad. Laken mah shenohagin lomar beyom hakkippurim "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed" meummad — muttar laamod keshemmaggia liqriat shema, ap al pi shehaya yosheb veyakol lekavven, mikkol maqom eno oseh mishshum chobat qeriat shema ella mishshum chobat hayyom:

Veim ratza liqrot kol hag' parashiyyot keshehu mehallek — hareshut beyado, millebad pasuq rishon shetztzerikin laamod mehilluko (o lesheb) veliqroto kede lekavven heteb. Vehu haddin im haya rokeb al gabbe behema — tzarik lehaamidah, sheeno yakol lekavven kol kak shehu tarud bahalikatah. Abal im yosheb baagala — en tzarik lehaamidah:

Ap al pi shellekattechilla tzarik lekavven bekol hag' parashiyyot — iqqar hakkavvana hi bepasuq rishon, shehu qabbalat malkut shamayim. Vehu haddin le"baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed", shehu gam ken qabbalat malkut shamayim. Abal mi"veahabta" veelak hu leshon tzavvaa. Lepikak im qara qeriat shema velo kivven libbo bepasuq rishon o be"baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed" — tzarik lachazor veliqrotan. Vaapillu haomerim shemmitzvot en tzarik kavvana modim bazeh sheim lo kivven libbo — lo yatza yede chobato min hattora, kemo shennitbaer besiman s'. Ukesheqqore pasuq "shema yisrael" paam shenit — yiqra belachash im hu betzibbur, shello yihyeh nireh kimqabbel b' rashuyyot. Veim lo nizkar shello kivven libbo ad leachar shessiyyem kol happarasha — tzarik lachazor larosh, shei epshar liqroto bemaqom shennizkar, mishshum shennimtza qoreah lemaprea velo yatza kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s"d:

Im haya yashen — metzaarim oto umeirim oto ad sheyyiqra pasuq rishon vehu er mammash sheyyukal lekavven. Mikkan veelak — en metzaarin oto kede sheyyiqra vehu er mammash, sheap al pi shehu qore mitnamnem — yatza. Veap al pi shellekattechilla tzarik lekavven bekullah — en matrichin umetzaarim oto bishbil kak, kevan shehu anus bashshena. Abal al kol panim metzaarim oto ad sheyyiqra kullo bepiv. Velo ones shena bilbad, ella hu haddin im anus ones acher shello yukal lekavven mi"veahabta" veelak — en matrichin alayv lekavven, kevan shehu anus:

Haqqore qeriat shema — lo yirmoz lechabero beenayv, velo yiqrotz bispatayv, velo yareh beetzbeotayv, vaapillu letzorek mitzva. Veim asa ken — alayv hakkatub neemar: "velo oti qarata yaaqob" ku', mippene shennireh keqore derek aray, vehattora omrah: "vedibbarta bam", vedareshu chakamim: aseh otam qeba. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beparasha rishona, mippene sheyyesh bitchillatah qabbalat malkut shamayim — hitzriku laasotah qeba. Abal mikkan veelak — muttar letzorek mitzva qetzat, keen maaseh shehaya sheshshana talmid bipne rabbo bammishna "zekarya ben qappotal", verabbo qara parasha sheniyya shel qeriat shema vehora lo beyado liqrot "qabbotal":
Haya oseq bimlaka veratza liqrot qeriat shema — yitbattel mimmelakto ad sheyyiqra qeriat shema parasha rishona, kede shello yihyeh keqore derek aray, vaapillu yakol lekavven:

Haummanin veken baal habbayit shehayu osin melaka berosh hailan o berosh shurot habbinyan — qorin qeriat shema bimqoman, veen tzerikim lered. Abal mikkol maqom tzerikim lehitbattel mimmelaktam beparasha rishona, kemo shennitbaer:
Hakkattap ap al pi shemmassao al ketepo — qore qeriat shema, mippene sheyyukal lekavven. Abal lo yatchil beshaa shettoen velo beshaa shepporeq, mippene sheen libbo meyushshab:
